Title: Revived on the Third Day
Promise: After two days his people would be revived, and on the third day raised up, so they would live in his sight, as surely as the morning and the latter rain come. Doubt: The words are the people's resolve and hopeful expectation ('let us return'), not God speaking a promise; the third-day language is also debated and should not be forced into a resurrection promise.
Condition: Returning to the LORD, as Hosea 6:1 urges.
